prompt: How can a docker-compose service be restarted when the healthcheck fails? Please, explain step by step.  Then, suggest code.
response: To restart a Docker Compose service when the healthcheck fails, you can use the `--remove-logs` option to remove the logs before restarting. This ensures that the logs are not affected. After restarting, you can check the status by running `docker-compose up -d`. This will force a full restart of the service.
